about: Which researched prices stand for which library machine (2 Nov 2026). Each class: the items used (file#index), the rule that admitted them, and every rejected item of that country/class with its reason. The builder (build-world.py) does the arithmetic: VAT-inclusive prices ÷ (1 + vat.json rate), then the median when more than one item is used.

rules.R1: same machine: the price names the model or carries a spec showing the size of the class (VMC travel within ~±30% of 762×406×508 mm; 5-axis table Ø400–650 mm; lathe 8–10" chuck; IMM 150–250 t for imm-200t, 900–1,400 t for imm-1200t; press brake 100–135 t × 3–3.2 m; small hobber ≤ 300 mm work)
rules.R2: one machine per price — a lot total is used only where the award gives the unit's line price
rules.R3: machine (incl. delivery / installation accepted and stated); minor standard accessories accepted and stated — a starter tooling kit, a mist collector, a probe, press-brake bending tools; refused: robots, automation, CAM / software, a second machine, a 'system', training, foundation / electrical works, a transformer or compressor, a multi-station classroom tooling set
rules.R4: ex-VAT: a VAT-inclusive price ÷ (1 + the PwC rate in vat.json); a price whose VAT is not stated is used as stated and says so
rules.R5: a 'from' price is the base model's, used at Low confidence; a clearance / display-unit price is used at Low and says so
